handoff.purpose: Define restrict_scores, Prolongation dataclass, prolongate_scores, and TemporalEvidence dataclass.

symbols.name: restrict_scores
symbols.note: Public function. Sums file scores up the hierarchy to all ancestors. Raises KeyError for unknown forest_node_id.

symbols.name: Prolongation
symbols.note: Frozen dataclass holding file_scores, selected_hierarchy_nodes, pruned_hierarchy_nodes. Has to_dict() method.

symbols.name: prolongate_scores
symbols.note: Public function. Projects restricted scores down the hierarchy with branch_limit. Returns Prolongation instance.

symbols.name: TemporalEvidence
symbols.note: Frozen dataclass with previous_id, current_id, kind, confidence, previous_score, carried_score.

claims.text: Input keys are authoritative Forest node IDs. Output keys are hierarchy IDs.
claims.why: Code iterates over file_scores keys (forest_node_id) and accumulates into restricted dict keyed by node.id (hierarchy ID).

claims.text: Unknown source IDs are rejected so a typo cannot silently alter the branch selection.
claims.why: If leaf is None (unknown ID), raises KeyError.

claims.text: The restriction sum makes a child/parent ratio a deterministic share of incoming relevance.
claims.why: share = float(restricted_scores[child.id]) / parent_score uses restricted_scores, which are sums from restrict_scores.

claims.text: Pruned mass is not renormalised onto other branches; doing so would make a surviving low-score file appear more relevant merely because its sibling was removed.
claims.why: No renormalisation occurs in code; pruned children are simply excluded.
Code explicitly checks if branch_limit < 1 and raises ValueError.
Code returns empty Prolongation if repository score is zero or missing.

claims.text: Bounded coarse-to-fine traversal and the relevance mass it preserves.
claims.why: The concept of 'bounded coarse-to-fine traversal' is not elaborated in this chunk; the class only stores data.
